{

  "version": "4.13.18",

    "test:fastly": "vp test --run --project fastly",

    "test:workerd": "vp test --run --project workerd",
    "test:all": "pnpm run test && pnpm run test:deno && pnpm run test:bun",
    "check": "vp check",
    "check:fix": "vp check --fix",
    "lint": "vp lint src runtime-tests build perf-measures benchmarks adapters",
    "lint:fix": "vp lint --fix src runtime-tests build perf-measures benchmarks adapters",
    "format": "vp fmt --check \"src/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"runtime-tests/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"build/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"perf-measures/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"benchmarks/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"adapters/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\"",
    "format:fix": "vp fmt \"src/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"runtime-tests/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"build/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"perf-measures/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"benchmarks/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"adapters/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\"",

    "copy:package.cjs.json": "cp ./package.cjs.json ./dist/cjs/package.json && cp ./package.cjs.json ./dist/types/package.json",
    "build": "pnpm run remove-dist && vp pack && pnpm run copy:package.cjs.json && publint",
    "watch": "pnpm run remove-dist && vp pack --watch && pnpm run copy:package.cjs.json",

      "types": "./dist/types/hono-base.d.ts",

      "require": "./dist/cjs/hono-base.js"
    },

part.text:
Fixed the header injection risk and verified it.

## Change

**`src/context.ts:768-782`** — `c.redirect()` now percent-encodes raw CR/LF in the `Location` value after the existing multibyte handling:

```ts
(!/[^\x00-\xFF]/.test(locationString) ? locationString : encodeURI(locationString))
  // Raw CR/LF would allow header injection, so always percent-encode them
  .replace(/[\r\n]/g, (char) => (char === '\r' ? '%0D' : '%0A'))
```

Why this placement:
- The ASCII branch previously passed CR/LF through verbatim, so a value like `\r\nSet-Cookie: ...` could split headers (or throw in strict `Headers` implementations).
- The `encodeURI` branch already encodes them; the `.replace` is idempotent for already-encoded `%0D`/`%0A` text since it only matches literal control characters.
- Valid redirects and pre-existing percent-encoded inputs (including `%0D%0A`) are untouched.

## Tests added to `src/context.test.ts:118-150`

- Raw `\r\n`, lone `\r`, and lone `\n` are encoded to `%0D%0A`, `%0D`, `%0A`, and no injected `Set-Cookie` header appears.
- Raw CR/LF combined with multibyte characters: `encodeURI` runs first, then the CR/LF encoding, preserving the multibyte behavior.
- Already percent-encoded `%0D%0A`/`%0D`/`%0A` inputs pass through unchanged (no double-encoding).

## Verification

```
pnpm exec vp test --run src/context.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       66 passed (66)
```

`context.ts` coverage is 94.54% statements / 100% branches. Changes are left unstaged for review.
